# Kinetic Construct (kinetic-serif v1.2.3)
> A high-density editorial design system with tactile chrome, Warm Alabaster surfaces, and Botanical Field semantic accents.

## Core Documentation

- [Design System Guide](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/guide.md): Editorial before ornamental, 3-role semantic rules, and spatial ergonomics.
- [Design Tokens (JSON)](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/kinetic-serif.json): Machine-readable CSS tokens, colors, typography scales, and chrome specifications.
- [AI Companion Skill](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/SKILL.md): Standard system prompt instructions for generating compliant architecture explainers.
- [Architecture Specimen](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/reference/architecture-spec.md): GCP Terraform specimen with four architectural laws. The supplied Conceptual Model enumeration is missing.
- [Full LLM Bundle](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/llms-full.txt): Consolidated guide, agent instructions, tokens, stylesheet, runtime, starter, and architecture specimen.

## Quick CDN Links

- [Stylesheet](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/css/kinetic-serif.css)
- [Runtime JS](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/js/kinetic-serif.js)
- [Starter Boilerplate](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/starter/index.html)

## Site & Source

- [Living Design System](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/): interactive 10-chapter reference.
- [Source Repository](https://github.com/Jeonkwan/kinetic-construct): maintained files and deployment workflow.
- [Complete Repository ZIP](https://jeonkwan.github.io/kinetic-construct/kinetic-construct-v1.2.3.zip): downloadable source bundle.

These absolute URLs can be used from other projects or standalone prompts. Hosted resources track the latest deployed main branch; use a chosen Git commit or vendored assets for a fixed revision.
